title: POST /api/projects/:id/ai/chat — AI PM chat endpoint (multi-provider)
description: Accept a user message, build project context, call the configured AI provider (OpenAI or Anthropic), and stream or return the response.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Returns 400 if user has no AI API key configured
Injects project context (vision, milestones, recent todos, journal, progress) into system prompt
Calls OpenAI or Anthropic based on user.aiProvider
Returns 500 if AI API call fails with user-friendly message

steps.description: Create AI router and POST /chat handler
steps.details: Create server/src/routes/ai.ts. POST /chat: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Fetch user — if no ai_api_key, return 400. 3) Decrypt api key. 4) Call buildProjectContext(projectId) (TASK-76). 5) If provider='openai': use OpenAI SDK with model='gpt-4o'. If provider='anthropic': use Anthropic SDK with model='claude-sonnet-4-6'. 6) Send system prompt with context + user message. 7) Return { response: text }.
Configure AI settings with a valid API key. POST a question about the project. Verify response is returned and contains relevant context. Try without API key — expect 400.

technicalNotes: Do NOT store AI responses in the database — each conversation is stateless
Keep system prompt concise — inject only: project type, vision (first 500 chars), top 5 milestones, last 3 journal entries, progress %, current level
Handle AI API errors gracefully — return 500 with message 'AI service unavailable'
